instruction: Set up Traefik with Let's Encrypt automatic TLS
output:
<think>
We're being asked to set up Traefik with Let's Encrypt automatic TLS.
Here's how I'd approach this.
mkdir is what we need — directory creation.
The -p flag handles create parent directories as needed. Important because without it the command won't work as we need.
The && chaining means each command only runs if the previous one succeeded. That's important for correctness.
A quick sanity check afterward saves debugging time later.
</think>
mkdir -p /etc/traefik && cat > /etc/traefik/traefik.yml << 'EOF'
api:
  dashboard: true
certificatesResolvers:
  letsencrypt:
    acme:
      email: admin@example.com
      storage: /etc/traefik/acme.json
      httpChallenge:
        entryPoint: web
entryPoints:
  web:
    address: :80
  websecure:
    address: :443
providers:
  docker: {}
EOF && docker run -d --name=traefik --restart=always -p 80:80 -p 443:443 -p 8080:8080 -v /etc/traefik:/etc/traefik -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock traefik:latest
